answer: Embodied challenge-response: each identity must complete a physical task—say, moving a token along a real vine trellis or traversing a room—verified by a co-located hardware witness that signs the trajectory. Since one operator controls one body at one place, it cannot concurrently satisfy challenges for many identities scattered across geography. A sybil must either recruit distinct humans at distinct locations or wander between sites, paying real travel time and per-witness hardware cost for every fake identity, as in any fable of clones.
